subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound parser gap is source-reproducible, but exposing form/select/card data while preserving existing button-command behavior is a channel payload contract decision.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce to direct inbound text
options.body: Scope this issue to top-level `interactive` message text extraction and leave action callbacks plus merge_forward entirely to their linked items.

options.title: Defer full structured payloads
options.body: Pause broad parsing until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card/form payloads beyond existing text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin contact, which is the clearest owner signal for a channel payload contract decision.
